items.title: When BILL, Zoho Books, and FreshBooks Stop Being Enough for Invoice-to-Cash
items.summary: When BILL, Zoho Books, and FreshBooks Stop Working Key Takeaways BILL.com’s cash application breaks down when customers bundle multiple invoices into one ACH transfer or use unrecognized reference numbers. Zoho Books offers a free plan for businesses under $50,000 annual revenue but lacks multi-currency support and collection efficiency metrics. Automated cash application, matching bank deposits to invoices, separates tools built for one-off billing from those handling recurring revenue. SaaS firms with high-volume subscription renewals often outgrow BILL.com once payment volumes exceed a few hundred transactions per month. BILL.com started as an accounts payable platform and excels at vendor bill pay, but its AR features rely on exact invoice number matching. Zoho Books’ reporting layer doesn’t surface aging receivables or collection metrics finance teams need once revenue crosses seven figures. Most integrated invoice-to-cash platforms handle invoice creation and payment collection well but struggle with automated deposit reconciliation at scale. Quick Comparison Summary
